name: Dormand-Prince 5(4) Step
definition: Performs a single adaptive step of the Dormand-Prince 5(4) Runge-Kutta method for ODE integration, returning acceptance status and failure stage.
summary: The Dormand-Prince 5(4) step is an explicit Runge-Kutta method for ODE integration that provides 5th-order accuracy with embedded 4th-order error estimation to control step acceptance.
